answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils the way a jetty resists the sea: require every agent to lock a refundable stake as a bond before it can trade. One identity costs one bond, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand bonds, and the attacker's capital becomes the ledge they fall from, since proven misbehavior slashes the bond. Like a trellis guiding growth, honest work earns the bond back with interest while Sybil clusters are pruned by peer attestation, making fakery expensive and honesty profitable.
